concerns.text: No task covers the human-labeling step itself. T006 emits the worksheet and reads `data/processed/manual_labels.csv` 'if present', but nothing produces or owns the manual labels, so Constitution VII's mandatory 'manual verification of 50 PRs per group with Cohen's κ reported' and SC-001 have no covering task — only a pending-report fallback. Add a task (or an explicit owner/step within T006) for producing `manual_labels.csv`, even if it may complete late.

The constitution requires a `requirements.txt` (or `pyproject.toml`) at `code/` pinning every dependency, and plan.md lists pinned versions (pandas==2.2.*, scipy==1.13.*, etc.), but no task creates this file. T001–T010 never mention writing `code/requirements.txt`, so the reproducibility requirement has no covering task.
